messages.author: Jenny 148
messages.body:
Dear all,
Could someone help me regarding how to visualize AMBER nc trajectory file
in pymol?  Thank you for any help
Jenny

messages.author: Kenneth Huang
messages.body:
Hi,
Someone who's used it more recently might be able to correct me, but I I
think it used to go something like-
load top.prmtop, obj01
> load_traj traj01.nc, obj01
>
I remember having issues with larger trajectories, so I'd probably suggest
going to VMD as a trajectory viewer instead if at all possible.
Best,
Kenneth
